name: Chroma Studio
actions: save transparent PNGs to browser Downloads outside the Workshop by default
optionally save to an explicitly chosen external folder
summary: A deterministic local hand that removes clean solid backgrounds and routes uncertain cuts to manual review instead of saving them.
notes: Output defaults to the browser's Downloads folder outside the Workshop, removing setup friction for platform pre-designs. The user can change to any explicitly chosen folder. No Workshop output folder is selected by default.
